jobs.summary: Job 289401 (LSF) is ~37.5 minutes into a clean restart-from-scratch, still the first attempt this session to run past mesh-setup and keep iterating -- 172 cycles, dt steady on dt_cfl, zero FATAL_ERROR. Memory has held flat at ~74.7-74.8GB for over 35 minutes, versus job 287064 still climbing hard toward its eventual 935GB OOM at a comparable elapsed time -- strong evidence the OOM fix is holding. Separately, the Catalyst zero-PNG issue has been root-caused and fixed in the script files: 7 of 8 registered scripts were missing the CONVERGE catalystcvt wiring (catalyst.Options()/catalyst_execute/catalyst_finalize) that actually triggers SaveExtracts(), verified by diffing against the working triangleRDE_weakIgnite scripts. All 7 have been patched to match. This fix is in the script files on disk but has NOT been picked up by this still-running job -- CONVERGE reads Catalyst scripts at process startup, so 289401 will keep producing zero frames until it's restarted.
